pages.text:
- Refinery Gas: the lightest cut of Crude Oil, a gas. Burns at 1,200°C in the Fuel Burner and the Gas Turbine Array, and runs the Diesel Generator. Burn off what you can't use in a Flare Stack.
- Naphtha: the hottest liquid Fuel Burner fuel (1,200°C), so it can boil Superheated Steam. Catches fire in the world.
- Kerosene: a clean, hot fuel (1,150°C), and Jetpack fuel. Catches fire in the world.
- Light Oil: burns at 1,000°C.
- Diesel: burns at 1,150°C, and runs the Diesel Generator. Catches fire in the world.
- Heavy Oil: a long, cool burn (750°C), and a turbine lubricant. Crack it into lighter fuels in the Cracking Unit, or blend it into Lubricant.
- Bitumen: the bottom of the barrel, thick as tar. The Coker turns it into Petroleum Coke and Refinery Gas.
See Refinery Fuels for Gasoline, made from Naphtha.
From Sour Crude Oil, Diesel and Kerosene come out sour: see Sour Crude.

- Pitch: a long-burning furnace fuel. Spin it into Carbon Fiber in a Fiberizer (1,000°C); Carbon Fiber makes Arcforged Alloy.
- Asphalt: 8 gravel around 1 pitch, or around a Bitumen bucket, makes 8. You walk, run and ride about 30% faster on it, and on its slabs and stairs.
